args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with error rate 0.18 after deploy. Rolled back to previous healthy release v2.3.0 in all regions.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Investigated**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with health checks failing and an 18% error rate. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was v2.3.0.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all production regions. The rollback was verified — all three regions now report v2.3.0, healthy, with error rate back down to 0.2%.

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident INC-0001 ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy") documenting the failure and the rollback to v2.3.0. The on-call engineer was paged.

Note: v2.3.1 remains the current release candidate issue — the incident is open so the on-call team can investigate the root cause of the v2.3.1 regression before any redeploy.
